subject: POC runway supplement: staged capacity top-up vs hourly engineering bridge
messages:

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Quick ask — two-week runway and small top-up options

Hi Hiro,

Hope you had a good weekend — we wrapped a refresh of our POC usage and we've got a tight sprint next week that will likely exceed the time-boxed credits we bought. Two quick questions:

1) Is there an option to add a short runway top-up (7–14 days) without re-contracting the whole pilot?
2) If we add capacity, what's the tradeoff between buying token credits vs purchasing an engineering hour block from Redwood (we might want some help with a prompt-engineering pass during the ramp)?

Attached is the usage extract for the past two weeks so you can see the burst pattern. We want to avoid any disruption to our internal demo on Oct 22.

Thanks — cc'ing Laura to loop sales in on commercial / procurement constraints.

Best,
Olivia
Product Manager | Orion Health

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — two-week runway and small top-up options

Hi Olivia — thanks for the data, that helps.

Short answers first: yes, we can do a one-off short runway top-up without a full amendment; and we can offer either token credits or an engineering-hour bundle. High-level tradeoffs:

- Token credits: fastest to provision, good for pure throughput/usage. We'll price the top-up as a prepay credit at a slightly discounted rate vs on-demand (typical mid-single-digit discount for pilot top-ups). Tokens give you full flexibility for the demo.

- Engineering hour block: priced separately (day-rate), includes: a 4–8 hour remote session for prompt tuning + a 2-hour handoff call. This is best if you want a focused prompt/pass to reduce token usage. It does not directly increase your token runway unless we pair it with a smaller credit top-up.

Options I recommend:
1) 14-day credit top-up: 40k tokens, provisioned same-day, 3% one-time top-up discount.
2) Hybrid: 20k token top-up + 1 engineering day (8 hours) — we can add an extra 10% discount on the tokens when bought with the hour bundle.
3) Emergency burst: 7-day unlimited burst guard (safety net) — higher premium but no interruptions (useful if you need the demo guaranteed).

I'll loop Laura to quote commercial and David for any PO/invoice terms. If you want, we can provision option #2 by EOD tomorrow to give you breathing room for the demo.

— Hiro

- For budget approval: I can sign off on a one-time 10% promotional concession on the token component for pilot customers if procurement can commit to a PO within 72 hours.
- Payment: standard net-30 invoice; we can also accept a credit-card charge for faster provisioning if that helps the demo timeline.

If you want to move forward, let me know which option you prefer and whether procurement will send a PO or you want to use a card. I'll attach the proposed top-up pricing PDF for review.
